name: hud_recti_segment_intersects_edge
description: HudRectI::SegmentIntersectsEdge builds the requested rectangle edge and returns edgeCode when a segment intersects it.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4162b0 builds the selected left/right/top/bottom edge, calls HudGeom2D::ClassifyPointAgainstSegment four times, and returns edgeCode when the two segment pairs straddle; HLIL has expected x87/jump-table temporaries.
The native rect-clip helper smoke verifies a left-edge intersection and a right-edge miss.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4162b0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
